sources.name: Appletini One USB1 startup hardening and text reader
sources.license: GPL-3.0-only except the Apache-2.0 CherryUSB hub derivative
sources.use: Selected USB3300 startup and shutdown checks; USB host lifecycle and hub allocation cleanup; native PHY test fixture and Python test runner; bounded text normalization and wrapping. Adapted file origins are recorded in licenses/files.csv. Earlier board and USB import pins remain unchanged.

sources.name: Appletini One CPU1 AMP startup and build pattern
sources.use: Selected ps_sources/lib/amp.c CPU1 release sequence and scripts/create_vitis_workspace.py AMP BSP and embedded-image build pattern. Also references compositor phosphor decay bands and blur/glow weights for the original Multitini native-frame implementation, and the ARM/Unicorn test setup. Multitini memory-only mailbox, worker and streaming transport are original. Per-file origins in licenses/files.csv.
